title: Mon 09 Nov 2026: AI rout pauses but Europe slips, strong US jobs lift Fed hike bets, crypto consultations close soon, fund services consolidate
summary: Chip stocks bounce on Friday but London and Europe close lower, while Asia rebounds this morning. A strong American jobs report lifts bets on a December Federal Reserve rise ahead of inflation data on Tuesday and UK growth on Thursday. In regulation, the crypto and DeFi consultations close on the eighteenth of November and the Senior Managers regime is up for reform. Plus fund services consolidation, three COO action points and the diary for the week.
